description: Adds, edits, or deletes a comment on an issue. Returns structured data with the comment URL, operation type, comment ID, issue number, and body echo.

createIfNone.description: When used with editLast, create a new comment if no existing comment exists (--create-if-none)

deleteLast.description: Delete the last comment (uses gh issue comment --delete-last)

editLast.description: Edit the last comment instead of creating a new one (--edit-last)

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

repo.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO format (default: current repo)

name: issue-comment
title: Issue Comment
